text:
Alex: Heads-up question — when we flip the default model for /v1/generate (no model param), how do we guarantee no silent regressions for older SDKs? Thinking about client pin behavior and deprecation comms.

Maria: Good catch. Plan is server-side default change + 60d overlap window. For those 60d we will honor an auto-pin if client sends `X-Redwood-SDK-Version` <= semver threshold so older SDKs keep the old model.

Sam: Quick clarifying q: what's the semver threshold? Is it \"<= 2.3.0\"?

Maria: We'll compute from telemetry; initial cutoff is 2.0.0 — we'll publish a mapping in docs.

Joel: Also: add a compatibility header `Prefer-Old-Model: true` so customers can opt into old behavior while they migrate.

Alex: Love the opt-in header. How about the fallback logic? server tries requested model -> if missing and header present -> return old default model; else return new default. Should we include a warning in response?

Priya: Yes include `x-redwood-compat-warning: model-deprecated-until-<ts>` and a `warning` object in body when behavior changed so SDKs can surface it.

Sam: Example request for SDK authors:
```
POST /v1/generate
Headers:
  Authorization: Bearer <key>
  Accept: application/json
  X-Redwood-SDK-Version: 1.9.4
  Prefer-Old-Model: true
Body: { "prompt": "..." }
```

Maria: Ops: rollout cadence — canary region 5% tomorrow, 25% day after, full after 72h if metrics OK. We'll automatically rollback if latency + error increase above threshold.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary -> region-us-west at 2598770000. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4321 :rocket:

Alex: What about SDKs that hardcode model strings? They won't be affected, right? Only omission changes.

Maria: Correct. Only the \"no model\" default flips. We'll also add a deprecation notice that the implicit default will be removed in 6 months to force explicit model selection.

Priya: I'll add a short dashboard alert (cost/latency delta) + release note. Also creating a small eval prompt set to detect quality regressions and tie alerts to that.

Joel: I'll write the docs blurb and upgrade guide by EOD. Can someone own the compat-matrix PR?

Sam: I'll take compat-matrix PR. Ping me @Sam.

Alex: Thanks — filing follow-ups: GH issues for telemetry checks (#5478), docs PR (#5482), and SDK heads-up email. :thumbsup:

Maria: OK closing this thread — follow-ups tracked in GH issues: #5478, #5482. Ping if you need more.
